claims: The Los Angeles Dodgers are playing the Arizona Diamondbacks at Dodger Stadium.
The game is on Friday, March 27, 2026, at 7:10 p.m. PDT.
Dodger Stadium is in Los Angeles.
The game is the second game of a three-game series to start the season.
The Dodgers' opening game was on March 26.
The game will be aired on Spectrum SportsNet.
The Dodgers return home on March 30 to begin a series against the Cleveland Guardians.
